extracted.stage: Pending grant of probate, expected within 13 weeks
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors enquires about a £21,000 probate loan for inheritance tax and legal fees against an estate valued at £803,500 while awaiting the grant of probate.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estate value of £803,500, the £21,000 requested for inheritance tax and costs, and that the grant is expected within approximately 13 weeks. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, details of the executors and their consent, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, confirmation of the IHT position and any relevant deadline date, and your firm's client care details. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please do let us know if any of the above has already been prepared.
